_comment: PT43 — high/critical advisories that scripts/audit-gate.mjs lets through, each read and judged. Every entry names its package directory ('scope': api or web), and needs a reason, a ticket and a review-by date ('until', YYYY-MM-DD); past that date the gate fails again. Remove an entry when the gate prints it as stale. Never add one without reading the advisory.

entries.reason: Memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections. Fix is zod 4 only (breaking API). Mitigated here: express.json caps bodies at 5 MB, and polygon rings/positions are counted on the raw arrays before zod parses them (geojson.ts MAX_POLYGON_RINGS / MAX_POLYGON_POSITIONS).
Local file inclusion: Node-only (jsPDF reading the filesystem). We run jsPDF in the browser only, from exportPdf.ts.
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: HTML injection in output('dataurlnewwindow'/'pdfobjectnewwindow') paths. exportPdf.ts only calls doc.save(); no new-window output.
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: ReDoS on attacker-controlled input to jsPDF parsers. Input is the user's own farm data rendered client-side in their own browser.
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: DoS via crafted input. Client-side only, the user's own data, their own tab.
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: PDF injection in AcroFormChoiceField. exportPdf.ts uses no AcroForm.
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: DoS via unvalidated BMP dimensions. exportPdf.ts adds one PNG it rendered itself from the map canvas; no BMP.
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: PDF object injection via addJS. exportPdf.ts never calls addJS.
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: DoS via malicious GIF dimensions. No GIF is ever added (one self-rendered PNG).
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: PDF injection in the AcroForm module (radio buttons). exportPdf.ts uses no AcroForm.
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: PDF object injection via FreeText annotation color. exportPdf.ts creates no annotations.
entries.ticket: PT43-fu2 (jspdf 2 -> 4, with a browser PDF-export check)

entries.reason: XSS sanitizer bypass in DOM.sanitize(), used by Popup.setHTML. The app creates no MapLibre Popup and never passes HTML to MapLibre. MapLibre is held at v3 deliberately (bundle budget, PT32); the fix is v6.
Dev-only: the web test runner (vitest 3 -> tinypool). Never shipped to the browser; exploitation needs prototype pollution inside our own test process.
